annotations.title: Product feed GTIN check: find invalid barcodes before upload

description: Check every product identifier in a CSV feed against the GS1 check digit. Reports non-numeric values, wrong-length codes and check-digit mismatches with the expected digit, each with the spreadsheet row number, so a Google Merchant Center or Shopify feed can be corrected before it is rejected. Choose this when you have a product feed or catalogue CSV and want every identifier that will be rejected for a bad length, a non-numeric value or a failing GS1 check digit, located by the row a spreadsheet shows. Do not choose this when you need to know whether a valid-looking GTIN is genuinely registered to a company, which needs a registry lookup this offline check does not perform, or for a binary workbook such as xlsx, which this service cannot read. Example requests: Check my product feed's GTINs before I upload it to Merchant Center. | Which barcodes in this catalogue have an invalid check digit? | Validate the UPC and EAN codes in this CSV and tell me which rows to fix.

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

content.description: The customer's input.csv, as text. Supported: CSV, TSV or any delimiter-separated text (comma, semicolon, tab, pipe). Maximum 1048576 bytes.

inputs.title: Product feed GTIN check: find invalid barcodes before upload

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_product_feed_gtin_check

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.
